description: Biogasanlagen Landkreis Diepholz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten-geoweb-diepholz.hub.arcgis.com. Locations of the requested and approved biogas plants in the district of Diepholz ---- The download service on this topic can be found under DOWNLOAD-LINKS ----. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Biogas plants District of Diepholz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Biogasanlagen, opendata, biogasanlage, Bio, inspireidentifiziert, Produktions- und Industrieanlagen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2020-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
